name: Create a deal
description: Create a deal. Create a new deal in the CRM with the specified name, attributes, and optional associations to contacts and companies. You can assign the deal to a specific pipeline and stage by providing `pipeline` and `deal_stage` attribute IDs, which can be retrieved from the pipeline details endpoint.
